lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: Capitol Hill, 2064, after midnight. The floor vote was this afternoon and the signatures are tonight, because the signatures are the part that matters.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: Empty seats. A lectern. A clerk with a register, required to witness every hand that signs and required to say nothing about any of them.

lines.speaker: mara
lines.text: I have never been allowed on this floor. Four years and eleven amendments and I have watched this room through glass.

lines.speaker: player
lines.text: The treaty went through this afternoon. Whatever is being signed at one in the morning is not the treaty.
